name_note: The literature name matches the GTDB name; a few genomes NCBI labels Porphyromonas somerae or Porphyromonas bobii fall inside this GTDB species cluster.

sentences.text: Porphyromonas pasteri is an obligately anaerobic, non-pigmented, non-spore-forming, non-motile, Gram-stain-negative rod, described from a strain isolated from human saliva.
16S rRNA gene sequence analysis placed the strain in the genus Porphyromonas, closely related to Porphyromonas catoniae, and its growth was inhibited on medium containing 20% bile.
A study of primary school children reported significantly higher relative abundances of the cohabiting group containing this species in children without a history of dental caries.
In adults with cystic fibrosis, its presence in sputum has been reported to accompany a greater annual rate of lung function decline.
